Fighting for Veterans & Their Families Every Day I am proud to have voted for the Historic PACT Act to ensure our service members get the critical health care benefits they have earned and deserve. Learn More Helping you cut through the Red Tape I want to serve my constituents in any way I can. Whether you need help with disaster assistance, a federal agency, are trying to find out if federal grants are available for your project, or are considering applying to a service academy. Learn more Lowering Health Care Costs Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, people with Medicare Part D drug coverage now pay nothing out-of-pocket for even more vaccines and will experience a price cap of $35/month on insulin. For the first time, Medicare will be able to negotiate directly with manufacturers for the price of certain high-spending brand-name Medicare Part B and Part D drugs that don’t have competition. Learn more Bringing Federal Dollars Back to the Tampa Bay Area The Tampa Bay Area is transforming thanks to historic legislation, federal investments from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law and Inflation Reduction Act and Community Project Funding I champion in the Congress. Learn more Investing in Students My office has annual opportunities for students to gain valuable experience in a Congressional office, receive a Service Academy nomination or show off their skills through an Art Competition and App Challenge. Learn more Join My Email List Subscribe to get the latest news and information. Meet Kathy Castor Kathy Castor is Tampa Bay’s voice in the U.S. Congress. She was elected in 2006 and represents Florida’s 14th Congressional district, which includes Tampa and parts of Hillsborough County. She is the first woman to represent Hillsborough and Pinellas counties in the U.S. Congress. LEARN MORE How Can I Help? Bill Benefits</span></strong><br /> </span></p> <p style="margin: 0in 0in 0pt;">Veterans whose post-9/11 GI Bill education benefits have been delayed can receive emergency payments, up to $3,000, at the <a href="http://www.vba.va.gov/ro/south/spete/index.htm">St. Petersburg VA Regional Office</a>. Veterans visiting the St. Petersburg VA Regional Office should bring a government-issued photo ID and a course schedule. Veterans in need of transportation to the regional office can request free van service by calling their nearest VA medical center.<br /> <br /> Veterans also can apply online at <a href="http://www.va.gov/"><span style="color: #606420;">www.va.gov</span></a>. Payments applied for online will be issued within three work days of your request.<br /> <br /> <br /> To help ensure the veterans in her district receive the benefits and care they have earned, Rep. Jobs & Economy | U.S. Representative Kathy Castor " /> Skip to Content Jobs & Economy Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Providing better-paying jobs for Tampa Bay is Rep. Castor's number 1 priority. She has successfully fought to bring new, good-paying job opportunities to Tampa Bay’s small businesses and large economic engines alike, including Port Tampa Bay, University of South Florida, Moffitt Cancer Center & Research Institute, Tampa International Airport, MacDill Air Force Base and federally qualified community health centers. She believes that a balanced approach for the budget charts a sustainable course for middle-class families, and has opposed measures that stand in the way of progress. Rep. Castor supports small businesses and community investments -- such as those in education, research and infrastructure -- that create jobs. In addition, Rep. Castor hosts a job fairs and job trainings info-sessions to connect our neighbors to higher-paying employment opportunities in Tampa Bay.  Related News U.S. Rep.
